extracted.name: Campari soda & blood orange pitcher
extracted.description: Hosting a crowd this Christmas? Throw together this simple pitcher, with Campari, Angostura bitters, orange-flavoured gin and blood orange soda
ingredient_lines: 1 orange (use a blood orange, if you can get one), sliced
500ml blood orange soda for topping up (you may need more, depending on the size of the jug)
instruction_lines: Fill a large jug to the brim with ice. Pour in the Campari and gin, then stir in the orange slices. Add a few dashes of Angostura bitters, then briefly stir. Top up with the blood orange soda and serve immediately.
